answer: Make every new identity vouched for by an existing one, and slash the voucher if the newcomer is caught cheating. Trust then builds up slowly like shale, layer on layer, and an agent who vouches for a sybil swarm loses its whole stake in one stroke. A fake cluster can grow a small mesa of mutual vouches, but its only bridge to the honest graph is a few sponsors who pay for every fraud, so a comet-fast burst of new accounts costs a full stake per bridge.
